threads.author: reviewer
threads.body: Please rename this variable to be more descriptive.

instructions: Optional: If you reject a code review suggestion, journal why: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <reason>'`.

`$DISMISS_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_active --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
